source_contract.score_only_evidence_disposition: retained for optimal-score and empirical-work claims; superseded by this v2 confirmation for canonical-policy claims

excluded_actions.reason: resident class has no arrivals in the three-class q01 protocol

arrival_model: independent class-wise Poisson arrivals using stream key aligned-frame:{seed}:{coordinate}
fixed_tape_rule: construct exactly one immutable tape for each (lanes, load, seed) and use it once for the registered canonical-v2 trajectory

selector_rule.initialization: fresh roots and frontier in every frame
selector_rule.early_stop: the call is exact only when no frontier region can improve the score or equal it with a smaller canonical key
selector_rule.canonical_key: ascending (duration, sorted option indices with idle encoded after every real option)
selector_rule.equality_pruning: a score-equal region is pruned only when its optimistic box-and-lane lexicographic key lower bound cannot beat the incumbent
selector_rule.accounting: sum each returned call's actual native work fields

online_information: each call receives only the current released queue, fixed catalogue, lane count, and K4096 cap
dispatch: global synchronous frames, FIFO within class, with arrivals during a frame eligible only at the next frame boundary
stopping_rule: stop arrivals at 600 seconds and drain the finite tape to completion

mean_utilization.quantity: sum actual LP calls / (4096 * visited frame count)

empirical_p95.quantity: actual LP calls in one visited frame / 4096
empirical_p95.claim: descriptive empirical tail gate on registered frames

matrix_work_accounting.derivation: option_count * (one lane row + queue_dimension resource rows + option_count box rows)
matrix_work_accounting.interpretation: a non-executed worst-case coefficient envelope; actual selector matrix cells are summed directly and no actual comparison baseline is claimed
matrix_work_accounting.gate: actual matrix sum must not exceed the arithmetic cap envelope; no matrix-utilization threshold is a scientific gate

registered_gate: one selector call per visited frame and every call is score-exact and canonical-exact within K4096
all jobs complete; queue recursion, FIFO decomposition, and every returned certificate are valid
no ordered-action or count-vector enumeration occurs in trajectories
actual LP mean utilization is strictly below five percent in every case and aggregate
empirical frame-level p95 actual LP work is at most ten percent of the cap in every case and aggregate
all actual LP and matrix work totals reconstruct from per-frame records
validation_boundary: complete ordered-action oracles are confined to small unit/regression tests; registered trajectories execute no comparator or enumeration

decision_rule.INVALID_EXECUTION: one or more registered execution-integrity checks fail
decision_rule.CANONICAL_EXACT_COMPUTE_CONFIRMATION_PAS: every visited frame closes both score and canonical action within one cold K4096 call; actual LP utilization is below five percent in every R/load case and in aggregate; and empirical frame-level p95 LP work is at most ten percent of the cap in every case and in aggregate
decision_rule.CANONICAL_EXACT_COMPUTE_CONFIRMATION_FAI: execution is valid but one or more frozen canonical-exactness or empirical bounded-compute gates fail

claim_boundary: An independent registered finite-horizon canonical-policy compute confirmation on eight fresh Poisson seeds per load for point-model synthetic identical-lane R8 and R16 systems. It establishes canonical action exactness and empirical work on these visited frames only. The older score-only cold confirmation remains valid for optimal-score and work evidence but is superseded here for canonical-policy claims. It is not an all-queue theorem, a performance advantage over another policy, a stability proof, joint95 physical closure, a physical multi-GPU measurement, or a deployment decision.
prohibited: post-result changes to seeds, horizon, loads, cap, utilization gates, or endpoints; restart or warm-start retries; an executed comparison policy; ordered-action or count-vector enumeration in trajectories; future-arrival access; paper or README edits
